name: Amos
lede: The thirtieth book of the Bible, in full: the herdsman of Tekoa — for three transgressions, yea, for four; the lion hath roared, who will not fear?; ye kine of Bashan; prepare to meet thy God, O Israel; let justice roll down as waters; the plumb-line, the basket of summer fruit and Amaziah of Beth-el; and the tabernacle of David raised up, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: For Three Transgressions
books.blurb: The words of Amos, among the herdsmen of Tekoa, two years before the earthquake: Jehovah will roar from Zion; for three transgressions of Damascus, of Gaza, of Tyre, of Edom, of Ammon, of Moab, of Judah — and of Israel, that sold the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of shoes; shall two walk together, except they have agreed?; the lion hath roared, who will not fear?; ye kine of Bashan; yet have ye not returned unto me; prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.

books.name: The Plumb-line
books.blurb: A lamentation for the virgin of Israel: seek me, and ye shall live; him that maketh the Pleiades and Orion; I hate, I despise your feasts — but let justice roll down as waters; woe to them that are at ease in Zion; then the visions: the locusts, the fire, and a plumb-line in the midst of my people; Amaziah of Beth-el and the herdsman and dresser of sycomore-trees; a basket of summer fruit; a famine of hearing the words of Jehovah; and the tabernacle of David raised up, the plowman overtaking the reaper.
